label: copy-phase fed-back w/x, late in long sequences
explanation: Very sparse (0.03% of steps). Fires only in the copy phase, and only when the fed-back input is w (about 53% of mass) or x (about 36%), with a small tail on l/h/m. Never fires in the original phase or at <DEL>. Rate goes up steeply with position: mostly L=9 (80% of mass), recall_idx >= 3, highest at t=16-17. Most top activations are w/x around recall 3-8 in L=9 sequences; previous tokens v/a/t/y/q raise the rate a little. The predicate covers about 85% of mass on dev but precision is about 1%: most w/x copy steps stay below threshold, and token, position and previous-token conditions do not separate them (best precision about 9%).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=w (+5.53), phase=2 & in_tok=x (+4.90), phase=2 & in_tok=l (+3.06), prev_tok=v (+2.58), phase=2 & in_tok=h (+2.46), prev_tok=a (+2.46). Lower it: recall_idx=1 (-2.45), out_tok=2 (-1.98), out_tok=- (-1.78), recall_idx=2 (-1.72).
